name: Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic
flagName: Flag of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic
summary: Black, white and green horizontal bands with a red triangle at the hoist and a red crescent and star in the white band. It is the flag of the Polisario Front's state, which claims Western Sahara, a territory mostly controlled by Morocco.
origin: The Polisario Front proclaimed the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic on 27 February 1976 after Spain withdrew from Spanish Sahara. Its flag is based on the Pan-Arab flag of the Arab Revolt, with a crescent and star.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: From the Arab Revolt flag; the colonial past.

symbols.name: Crescent and star
symbols.description: A red crescent and star in the white band.

facts: The SADR is a full member of the African Union.
Most of Western Sahara is administered by Morocco; the Polisario controls the eastern zone beyond the Moroccan berm.
Its layout closely follows the Palestinian flag, with an added crescent and star.
clues: Black, white and green bands with a red hoist triangle and a red crescent and star.
Its state is an African Union member but controls only part of its claimed territory.
Like Palestine's flag with a crescent and star added.
